plugins.name: clear-reminder
plugins.description: Counts prompts since the last /clear and reminds you to clear before the limit

plugins.name: clawd-spinner
plugins.description: Pixel-art Clawd acts out the spinner word above the prompt while Claude works

plugins.name: done-sound
plugins.description: Plays a sound when Claude finishes answering

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Status line with context fill, turn time, turn tokens, session cost and the 5-hour limit

plugins.name: session-diff
plugins.description: Pane listing the files changed this session with line counts and their diffs

plugins.name: prompt-score
plugins.description: Toasts a heuristic quality score (PromptTelemetry rules) for each prompt you send

plugins.name: todo-pane
plugins.description: Live pane of Claude's todo list (TodoWrite / Task tools) with a progress bar

plugins.name: agents-pane
plugins.description: Live pane of running subagents with elapsed time and a stop button

plugins.name: git-band
plugins.description: Branch, changed-file count and ahead/behind above the prompt

plugins.name: time-tracker
plugins.description: Tracks how long Claude works per project per day; /zaman shows the last 7 days

plugins.name: session-journal
plugins.description: Logs each turn to a daily markdown journal; /gunluk adds a model-written summary of the session

plugins.name: sys-meter
plugins.description: Status line with CPU load, RAM usage and CPU temperature, refreshed every 5 seconds (Windows)

plugins.name: ask-alert
plugins.description: Windows toast and sound when Claude waits for you: permission prompt, AskUserQuestion or idle prompt
